[Thinking]
**Planning search report structure**

I’m thinking about how to structure the report on the incident. I’ll refer to “tracking teams” instead of mentioning dogs. I’ll also include details about remote cameras and radar. There were divers pulled out for safety, and I want to quote the minister. I need to cover high-pressure water jets and excavators dealing with debris from last year's soil slip.  

I should have five paragraphs: an introduction, a section on the incident, a part on search efforts, one bullet point, and a conclusion. The bullet point will be in paragraph four. I’ll aim for 140-170 words and end with the specified phrase.
[/Thinking]

"The search for Indian tourist Vijaya Lakshmi Gali, who vanished after a sinkhole opened in Kuala Lumpur, has been halted after officials judged further efforts too dangerous for rescue crews. The incident has drawn major attention as hopes of finding her have faded over more than a week.  
***  
Gali was walking along a city road on 23 August when the pavement abruptly gave way. She fell about 8 metres into the opening and did not resurface. So far, teams have recovered only her slippers and have not located any other sign of her.  
***  
Responders have used remote cameras, ground-penetrating radar, and tracking support while exploring linked underground drainage routes. They also attempted to clear sections using high-pressure water jets and excavation equipment to remove blockage and debris.  
***  
* On the eighth day, authorities said sending divers farther down was too risky; two divers entered earlier but were pulled out before reaching an obstruction, and a prior soil slip had been reported at the same site last year.  
***  
A minister cited the safety and health of personnel as key reasons for stopping, and the operation remains at a standstill while officials weigh hazards and options. Is there anything else I can help with?"
